summary: Crypto-suite is structurally sound: codepoint dispatchers fail-closed across hash/sig/cipher surfaces; X-Wing combiner binds both KEM halves + both encapsulated keys + both public keys for strip-resistance; hybrid Ed25519+ML-DSA-65 NF-4 commitment binds both pubkeys + both sigs + msg; HKDF info-tags 'root'/'step' provide cross-role domain separation; AeadEnvelope wire format carries explicit format-version byte (Gate-6); AAD-binds-plaintext-CID rebinding-attack defense holds; pure-PQ sole-trust-path is structurally gated by AUDIT_LANDED_PURE_PQ_FLAG (compile-time false) with named typed-error AuditNotLandedPurePqRejected. The 0x647c pre-FREEZE bundle mint + force_pure_pq_for_test_bypassing_audit_gate side-door correctly preserve the C11b invariant in production while enabling end-to-end test exercise. EncryptionClass enum (benten-core) is orthogonal to the cipher-suite dispatcher (outer Public/Confidential class layer; inner cipher-suite codepoint dispatches the suite). One MAJOR finding: V1-FROZEN row 6 codepoint table mislabels 0x0003 (HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA) as 'LIVE swap-matrix arm' — the actual SigCodepoint::resolve / SignatureSuite::resolve_codepoint / varsig.rs decode_payload all typed-reject 0x0003. The framing should mirror 0x647c's row ('reserved swap-matrix arm; typed-rejected by default; reachable only via SwapMatrix audit-gated constructor'). Two MINOR findings around diagnostic-information loss (unsupported_codepoint_msg_static swallows codepoint value) and stale docstring in codepoint.rs:30-31 (claims G-CORE-3c will flip 0x0003 LIVE; G-CORE-3c has shipped and 0x0003 stays typed-rejected at dispatcher per C11b gate). Two OBS items around future P-III freeze decisions.
convergence_signal: Substrate is cryptographically sound; the one MAJOR is a doc-truth-vs-code-truth mismatch (the code is correct per C11b; the freeze-table needs to be amended to reflect it). All MINOR + OBS are surgical. No BLOCKER findings.

findings.title: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE row 6 codepoint table mislabels 0x0003 (HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA) as 'LIVE swap-matrix arm' — actual dispatchers typed-reject it
sites: crates/benten-crypto-suite/src/varsig.rs:114 (decode_payload only handles 0x0001 + 0x0002; 0x0003 unreachable per resolve gate at boundary)
findings.evidence: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:477 states `SigCodepoint::HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA | 0x0003 | LIVE swap-matrix arm (NF-1 end-state per G-CORE-3c)`. But codepoint.rs:104 `0x0003 => Err(UnsupportedAlgorithm::Signature { codepoint: self.0 })` typed-rejects every dispatch through the canonical SigCodepoint::resolve gate. sig.rs:308 SignatureSuite::resolve_codepoint also returns Err for 0x0003. varsig.rs::decode_payload only matches 0x0001 + 0x0002 (0x0003 caught at earlier resolve()). The swap_matrix.rs pure-PQ arm CAN sign+verify under 0x0003 via the in-module dispatch but the produced signature_bytes can never round-trip through the UCAN-Varsig wire surface, and any external consumer reaching the codepoint dispatcher first sees typed-reject. This is the EXACT mirror of how 0x647c is handled (typed-reject at cipher-suite dispatcher; reachable ONLY via SwapMatrix::try_pure_pq_sole_trust_path audit-gated constructor) — but the V1-FROZEN row 6 table treats 0x647c as 'reserved swap-matrix arm; typed-rejected by default — gated by AUDIT_LANDED_PURE_PQ_FLAG per the C11b safety gate' (line 482) and 0x0003 inconsistently as 'LIVE swap-matrix arm'. The behavior is consistent (both are C11b-gated); the freeze-table wording is not.
findings.fix_now_action: Amend V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:477 to mirror line 482's framing: `SigCodepoint::HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA | 0x0003 | reserved swap-matrix arm (NOT default; typed-rejected at SigCodepoint::resolve / SignatureSuite::resolve_codepoint / UCAN-Varsig decode; reachable ONLY via SwapMatrix::try_pure_pq_sole_trust_path audit-gated constructor per the C11b safety gate; NF-1 end-state arm)`. Add a no-regression test pin to crates/benten-crypto-suite/tests/ asserting (a) SigCodepoint::HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA.resolve() returns Err(UnsupportedAlgorithm::Signature { codepoint: 0x0003 }), (b) SignatureSuite::resolve_codepoint(SigCodepoint::HYBRID_MLDSA65_SLHDSA) returns Err matching codepoint 0x0003, (c) UcanVarsigV1Header::decode of a header carrying codepoint 0x0003 returns Err(VarsigError::UnsupportedCodepoint { codepoint: 0x0003, .. }). The pin is the freeze-load-bearing 'wording-mutation' guard per §3.5g.
findings.rationale: Per the freeze discipline: the codepoint table is BYTEWISE PERMANENT and the V1-FROZEN doc is the single source of truth a future agent reads to understand the surface. A 'LIVE swap-matrix arm' label on 0x0003 is wrong (the dispatcher typed-rejects), would lead a future contributor to incorrectly assume cross-peer interop works under 0x0003, and undermines the C11b mental model. The fix is documentary (matching the actually-shipped behavior to the freeze-doc claim) + adds the no-regression dispatcher-typed-reject pin (per pim-cite-drift-fp1-recurrence freeze-time tightening).

findings.title: SwapMatrix::unsupported_codepoint_msg_static discards the codepoint value carried by UnsupportedAlgorithm
findings.evidence: swap_matrix.rs:1575 `fn unsupported_codepoint_msg_static(_e: &UnsupportedAlgorithm) -> &'static str { "cipher-suite codepoint typed-unsupported" }` ignores the typed error envelope's actual codepoint value, returning a static string. Callers at lines 438-440 + 539-541 wrap the typed error as `SwapMatrixError::CipherSuite(unsupported_codepoint_msg_static(&e))` which loses the diagnostic information (the actual unrecognized codepoint value). The SwapMatrixError enum already has a `Unsupported(#[from] UnsupportedAlgorithm)` variant (line 793) that preserves the typed-codepoint info perfectly.
findings.fix_now_action: Replace the two call sites (swap_matrix.rs:438-440 + 539-541) with `.map_err(SwapMatrixError::Unsupported)` (no helper fn needed; the From impl on `Unsupported` variant handles the conversion directly). Delete the now-unused `unsupported_codepoint_msg_static` helper. Preserves typed-error info end-to-end + simplifies the cipher-suite resolve failure path.
findings.rationale: Diagnostic-information loss + a redundant helper. Both the codepoint value (for debuggability) and the structured typed-error variant (for downstream matching) are erased; the simpler-and-better From-impl path exists already. ~6 LOC edit total.

findings.title: AeadEnvelope wire-format `to_wire_bytes` panics via `.expect` on nonce length > 255 (unreachable today; future-proofing risk)
findings.evidence: aead.rs:168-171 `out.push(u8::try_from(self.nonce.len()).expect("AEAD nonce length fits in u8 (ChaCha20-Poly1305 = 12)"));`. The `.expect` is correct today (all v1-beta cipher-suite arms produce 12-B nonces; the AeadEnvelope constructor `wrap` always builds 12-B nonces). But the future-AEAD-codepoint additive-discipline (e.g. XChaCha20-Poly1305 with 24-B nonces) is fine; an algorithm with >255-B nonces (cryptographically implausible; XChaCha20 is the max in practice at 24 B) would panic. Not a freeze break — additive-codepoint discipline lets a future AEAD swap in without affecting the v1 surface — but the panic-on-overflow contract is implicit.
findings.fix_now_action: Either (a) widen the nonce-length prefix to u16 LE at the freeze (would break v1-beta wire format — NOT recommended), OR (b) document the invariant explicitly + extend the additive-codepoint discipline narrative: 'All Benten-blessed AEAD codepoints commit to nonces ≤ 255 B; any future codepoint with a longer nonce REQUIRES a new envelope-format-version arm.' Add this to crates/benten-crypto-suite/src/aead.rs module docstring + reference from V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 6 (codepoint additive-discipline) escape-valve section. ~10 LOC docs edit.
findings.rationale: Trivial doc-clarification + freeze-time hardening. Preserves the actually-correct invariant (12-B today; all RustCrypto-blessed AEAD candidates ≤ 24 B) while making explicit the additive-codepoint contract the freeze relies on.
